trigger_condition: cut sample inside a multibyte sequence, tail missing a continuation byte
failing_behavior: lenient decoder returns valid-looking short output, exit code 0

trigger_condition: execution succeeds returning a zero-length artifact, exit code 0
failing_behavior: downstream reads zero output as success, exit code 0, every assertion green

trigger_condition: one round writes two run records with the same run identifier, aggregation silently deduplicates
failing_behavior: aggregation collapses two run records into one, real count one lower than the ledger, exit code 0

trigger_condition: two rounds execute under one round identifier, cross-round merge counts two executions as one
failing_behavior: cross-round merge counts two executions as one, round count one short, exit code 0
